name: foothold
description: Installable Obsidian vault pack for defence-sector founders. One command lays down a working second-brain: folder structure, page templates, skills, and pre-populated open-source defence reference content. Plugin-bundled skills (lifecycle): /foothold-setup (install and conversational onboarding) and /foothold-update (pull new content into an existing pack without re-running setup). Vault-bundled skills (shipped into the installed vault's Skills/ folder, sync via Obsidian Sync): add-contact, add-organisation, and add-event.
